$comment: Performance budget register (plans/40-platform-quality.md Q3 deliverable 6). Checked by scripts/audit/check-budgets.mjs. Values are the plans' own; null means the plans give no number. dueBy is the date by which the row must have a first measurement (roadmap days: day 1 is 2026-10-27); a never-measured row is reported as awaiting until then and fails after it. maxAgeDays and lastMeasured (an ISO date) are filled in when a row is first measured. calibrate = set from the first run on the owner's Mac and written to DECISIONS.md. Gates: hard-3x (fails at 3x the budget), trend-10pct, record, tighten-only (alertPct, when present, is the allowed rise before an alert), required, release (a release gate, run for the release candidate).
